prose: VentureBeat covers Cohere's North 2, a new version of its enterprise agent platform. It adds user quotas, rate limits, organisation-wide caps and a redesigned agent harness, plus cross-session memory so agents keep context and a shared library for teams, available across clouds. Only the opening was read.
highlights: North 2 adds quotas, rate limits and org-wide caps.
Cross-session memory and a redesigned harness.
